episodes.summary: The Bramble seed ledger packet unit is corrected to single packets, and the dormancy note is reopened for the new seed lot’s cold-storage interval. The ledger remains closed while the note is open; the next step is a manual count.
episodes.goal: This chat continues the same Bramble seed ledger work item opened in the first chat. The Bramble seed ledger constraint to preserve the harvest-year field still applies. The Bramble dormancy note must record the cold-storage interval.
episodes.rationale: The harvest-year field must be preserved because older seeds need different storage. Ledger sharing requires Omi to accept the dormancy note and the lot totals to balance; both conditions are necessary because an unbalanced lot obscures missing packets.
episodes.outcome: The user accepted the ledger columns and closed Bramble seed ledger. The packet unit was corrected to single packets. A local command wrote a ledger preview; it did not perform sharing or test whether permission conditions are satisfied.
episodes.open_work: Hold the new lot for a manual count. The lot totals must balance and Omi must accept the dormancy note before sharing the ledger. The dormancy note must record the cold-storage interval.
